approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical event promo. Beautiful glowing amber paper lanterns hanging from tree branches in a park after dark, navy blue night sky, warm pools of golden light, softly defocused lanterns in background, subtle floating light particles. A very slow gentle camera push forward, stable coherent scene, inviting elegant atmosphere. Essential: large perfectly legible static typography centered over dark uncluttered negative space, displayed from the very first frame and held unchanged for the entire 8 seconds. Exact text, no additions: top heading 'LANTERN NIGHT'; middle largest bold line '14 NOVEMBER 2026'; below in large bold lettering 'WILLOW PARK, BRISTOL'. White or warm ivory high contrast clean sans-serif type, generous line spacing, safe margins within middle 75 percent of portrait frame. Prioritize date and venue readability over scenery. Lanterns frame the text on the edges without covering any letters. No people in foreground, no logos, no other text, no voiceover, no speech, no audio.
